score_update: At the logged timestamp of a counted goal event. Count Shot/Goal or Own Goal Against once; ignore Own Goal For counterpart and shootouts.
action_state: Score immediately before the action by event index. Preserve original selected action IDs and registered clock/index bounds.
time_exposure: Split the original registered elapsed-millisecond interval at counted goal timestamps; retain added/extra time and remove halftime gaps as in lesson64.
rates: Pool action counts and state-specific milliseconds before division. Zero state exposure gives an undefined rate, even if a boundary action is present.
limitation: Logged goal-event times approximate score-change instants; this is descriptive score context, not a causal tactical effect or adjustment for opponents/possession.
